messages.content: I reviewed the Montelucia confirmation. Please verify whether the breakfast credit is per person or per room, confirm the full resort total, and check the Friday spa appointments and transportation costs.

The breakfast credit is $60 per room per day, not $60 per guest. It applies on each of the four mornings and cannot be carried forward. The lodging total remains $2,018.00: the $504.90 deposit is paid and $1,513.10 is due at check-in. Taxes and the mandatory resort fee are included; incidental purchases are additional.
That is less breakfast value than I expected, but keep the room. What exactly is showing for the spa? We had a Saturday couples massage confirmed.

The Saturday 2:30 p.m. couples massage is still confirmed at $829.60. The spa also has two Friday 80-minute massage openings, one at 10:00 a.m. and one at 11:30 a.m. They cannot be performed simultaneously. Each costs $402.60 including service charge and requires a separate $100 deposit. The balance for each is due after treatment. The deposits are refundable with at least 24 hours' notice.
Switch us to the Friday appointments. The different times are fine. Cancel Saturday, but only if there is no penalty.
The Saturday appointment can be canceled now without penalty. Replacing it with the two Friday treatments makes the spa total $805.20, with $200 charged now as two deposits and $605.20 due Friday.
Proceed with that change. Then compare the private transfer with rideshares for Thursday arrival and Monday departure.

The Saturday couples massage has been canceled with no charge. Friday massages are confirmed at 10:00 and 11:30 a.m.; two $100 deposits were charged separately. A private round-trip PHX transfer is $248 including taxes and gratuity, with flight monitoring and a 45-minute arrival wait. Estimated rideshares are $48-$62 Thursday and $54-$70 Monday, or $102-$132 total, excluding surge pricing.
Book the private transfer. The fixed pickup is worth the difference, especially for Monday. Use the flight details already ticketed and set the resort pickup for 3:45 p.m.

The private round-trip transfer is confirmed for $248, charged in full. The driver will meet the March 12 arrival at PHX and monitor the inbound flight; return pickup is March 16 at 3:45 p.m. from Montelucia. The trip now totals $3,627.20 before meals and other incidentals: $556 flights, $2,018 lodging, $805.20 spa, and $248 transportation. The room balance is $1,513.10, and the remaining spa balance is $605.20.
